info.title: Oore CI API
info.description:
REST API for Oore CI — a self-hosted, Flutter-first mobile CI and internal app distribution platform.

The backend daemon (`oored`) exposes this API on the configured listen address. All endpoints under `/v1/` use JSON request/response bodies unless noted otherwise.

## Authentication

- **Setup endpoints** (`/v1/setup/*`) are token-gated by a bootstrap session token and auto-disabled after setup completes.
- **Auth endpoints** (`/v1/auth/*`) support Local Only login, single-use local recovery in Ready External Access mode, and configured OIDC or trusted-proxy flows.
- **Protected API endpoints** declare their session, API, or runner bearer-token requirement individually.
- **Callbacks, webhooks, metrics, readiness, and signed-token delivery routes** use their route-specific public, state, signature, or token contract instead of a global bearer requirement.

## Base URL

Since Oore CI is self-hosted, the base URL is your daemon's listen address (e.g. `http://localhost:8787`).

Server-sent event stream of build, runner and release changes, so
clients can refresh without polling. Every connection starts with a
`ready` event (`EventStreamReady`). Then: `build` (`BuildChangedEvent`),
`release` (`ReleaseChangedEvent`), `runner` (`RunnerChangedEvent`, only
for users who can read runners), `resync` (`EventStreamResync`, events
were dropped and clients should refetch) and `done` (the stream ends,
data is the reason). Build and release events are limited to projects
the caller can read. Events are not replayed, so a client that
reconnects should refetch once on `ready`. Comment keepalives are sent
every 15 seconds.

post.description:
Writes the pipeline's form settings as a `version: 2` `.oore.yaml`,
with `on` from the trigger settings and `publish` from the Publish
settings where they map exactly. The file is planned before it is
returned and runs what the settings run. Secret values and store
credentials never appear in it; secret references stay as written.

200.description: The file, or why the settings cannot be exported

post.description:
Reads a `version: 2` `.oore.yaml` back into the pipeline's form
settings: the inverse of the export. The file is validated as
`oore pipeline validate` does. Settings are returned only when the
form can hold the whole file; exported again, they plan the same as
the file. Everything else is listed in `unsupported`. Nothing is
saved, and secret references stay as written.

200.description: The form settings, or why the file cannot become them

post.description:
Resolves the steps a build would run for a `.oore.yaml` or the
pipeline's form settings, with the same validation as
`oore pipeline validate`. Environment values are never returned and
secret references stay as written.

file.description: Path relative to the build workspace, such as `lib/main.dart`.

AppStoreConnectKeySummary.description:

pipeline_count.description: Pipelines whose iOS signing uses this key.

AppStoreDestination.description: Where an App Store Connect upload goes once Apple finishes processing it.

App Store publishing settings for a pipeline, stored as the `app_store`
publish target. Uploads use the App Store Connect API key from the
pipeline's iOS signing settings and require the `app_store` export method.

phased_release.description: Release the approved version with Apple's seven-day phased release.

release_notes.description: TestFlight "What to Test" or App Store "What's New", per locale.

submit_for_review.description: Submit the App Store version for review once the build is attached.

testflight_groups.description: TestFlight group names. Used when `destination` is `testflight`.

uses_non_exempt_encryption.description: Export compliance answer set on each processed build.

AppStoreReleaseNote.description: Release notes for one App Store Connect locale, such as `en-US`.

ApprovalPolicy.description:
Which builds of a pipeline wait for a maintainer before a runner may
claim them.

events.description:
Trigger events that need approval: `push`, `pull_request`,
`tag_push`, `manual` or `schedule`. Empty means every build.

expires_after_hours.description:
Hours a build waits for a decision before it is canceled. Defaults
to 168 (7 days).

ApproverRole.description: The lowest project role that may approve promotions into an environment.

ArtifactSizeComparison.description: One artifact's size, and its change from the matching baseline artifact.

baseline_name.description: Name of the baseline artifact this one was matched with.

oneOf.description: Present when the pipeline's approval policy gated this build.

retry_steps.description:
Steps this build retries against `source_build_id`'s stored artifacts.

workflow.description:
The `.oore.yaml` version 2 workflow this build plans. Absent for
files without workflows and for pipelines configured in the UI.

diagnostics.description: The most severe diagnostics, errors first, at most 50.

BuildAnalysisBaseline.description:
The earlier build an analysis compares with: the latest successful build
of the same pipeline on the base branch that reported one, as for sizes.

oneOf.description: `null` when the build reported no analysis.

base_branch.description:
The branch the build compares with: a pull request's target branch,
otherwise the default branch.

BuildApprovalState.description: Build approval state. Pending builds stay `queued` but no runner claims them.

BuildChangedEvent.description: `build` event on `GET /v1/events`: a build was created or changed.

retryable_steps.description:
Steps of this finished build that `POST /v1/builds/{build_id}/retry-step`
can run again without rebuilding.

author_email.description: Email of the person who sent it.

BuildInsightsDay.description: One day of finished builds, in the caller's UTC offset.

day_start.description: Unix seconds at the start of the day.

p50_duration_seconds.description: Median run time of the day's succeeded builds.

daily.description: One entry per day of the window, oldest first.

duration.description: Run time (start to finish) of succeeded builds in the window.

failing_pipelines.description: Up to five pipelines with the most failures in the window.

previous_duration.description: Run time of succeeded builds in the previous window.

previous_totals.description: The same window length immediately before `since`, for comparison.

projects.description: Projects with finished builds in the window, most builds first.

queue_wait.description: Time from queued to started for builds that started in the window.

since.description: Start of the window, in unix seconds.

totals.description: Builds that finished in the window.

BuildOutcomeTotals.description: Outcome counts for builds that finished in a window.

success_rate.description:
`succeeded / (succeeded + failed + timed_out)`. Canceled and expired
builds never ran to a verdict, so they are left out. Absent when no
build reached a verdict.

BuildQueueSnapshot.description: Builds waiting or running right now.

awaiting_approval.description: Queued builds held for a maintainer's approval.

oldest_waiting_since.description: When the longest-waiting build was queued, in unix seconds.

waiting.description: Queued and scheduled builds that a runner can pick up.

BuildSizeBaseline.description: The earlier build a size report compares against.

base_branch.description:
Branch the build is compared with: a pull request's target branch,
otherwise the project's default branch. Absent when neither is known.

oneOf.description:
The latest earlier successful build of the same pipeline on
`base_branch` that recorded artifact sizes.

flaky.description: The test failed, passed, then failed again within the history window.

history.description: Recent builds of this pipeline that reported tests, oldest first, ending with this build.

history_window.description: How many recent test-reporting builds the history and flaky check cover.

oneOf.description: Absent when the build reported no test results.

BuildTestSummary.description: Totals across every test report of a build.

active_build_ids.description:
The builds the runner is still running. The backend releases any
other build it holds, since the runner lost it.

retry_steps.description:
Set when the job only retries these steps with the source build's
stored artifacts, instead of building.

signing_token.description:
Ephemeral capability required for runner-owned signing material fetches.
It is scoped to this job and revoked when the job leaves active execution.

token.description: The plaintext token. Only returned on creation, never again.

private_key_base64.description: Base64 of the `.p8` file downloaded from App Store Connect.

app_version.description: App version the tester installed, such as `2.4.0+118`.

artifact_id.description: The build's artifact the tester installed. Must belong to this build.

message.description: What the tester saw. 1 to 4000 characters.

os_version.description: Operating system and version, such as `Android 15` or `iOS 18.1`.

screenshot_base64.description:
Optional PNG, JPEG or WebP screenshot, base64 encoded, at most 5 MiB
decoded. Requires artifact storage.

platforms.description: Optional one-run platform selection. Omitted builds every platform configured by the pipeline.

workflow.description:
The `.oore.yaml` version 2 workflow to build. Omitted uses the
pipeline's default workflow, then the file's only workflow. A file
with several workflows and no default needs one named here.

events.description: Events to notify on. Empty or omitted means all events.

project_id.description: Scope the channel to one project. Omit for an instance-wide channel.

secret.description:
Webhook: HMAC secret for signing payloads. Slack: bot token with
`users:read.email`, used to mention the triggering user. Optional.

slack_mentions.description: Slack member IDs to mention (Slack only). Works without a bot token.

oneOf.description: SMTP configuration (required for email channel type).

url.description: Incoming webhook URL (required for webhook, mattermost and slack).

workflow.description: A workflow the repository's `version: 2` file defines.

oneOf.description: Who may approve promotions. Defaults to any project maintainer.

submit_for_review.description:
App Store track only: submit the version for App Review after a
promotion attaches the build.

rollout_fraction.description: Initial fraction; defaults to the first policy step.

oneOf.description: Initial state; defaults to `rolling`.

single_use.description: If true, token is consumed after first download.

ttl_secs.description: TTL in seconds (default: 86400 = 24 hours, max: 604800 = 7 days).

CreateSigningIdentityRequest.description: Create a signing identity. Set the input matching `kind`.

reference.description: Branch, tag, or commit requested for discovery.

truncated.description: True when more matching files existed than the bounded response could inspect.

DurationPercentiles.description: Median and 90th percentile of a duration, in seconds.

EnvironmentApprover.description: A project member named as an approver.

EnvironmentApprovers.description:
Who may approve or reject promotions into an environment.

A member may decide when their project role is at least `role`, or when
they are one of `users` (developers and maintainers only). With no role
and no users, any project maintainer may decide, as before approvers
existed. Instance owners and admins may always decide. API tokens never
decide: approvals are interactive.

oneOf.description: A developer role lets developers and maintainers approve.

users.description:
Project members named as approvers. A user who leaves the project,
or becomes a viewer, stops counting.

EnvironmentApproversInput.description:
Approvers to set on an environment. Replaces the whole set; send an empty
object to go back to "any maintainer".

user_ids.description:
User ids of project members who are developers or maintainers. At
most 20.

EnvironmentPromotion.description: A request to put an existing build into an environment.

can_decide.description: Whether the caller may approve or reject this promotion now.

release_id.description: The release the promotion created, once completed.

source_environment_name.description: Where the source release was, when it belongs to an environment.

source_release_id.description: The release the build is promoted from.

EventStreamReady.description:
`ready` event, the first event on every `GET /v1/events` connection.
Clients refetch once on `ready` after a reconnect, since events sent while
disconnected are not replayed.

EventStreamResync.description: `resync` event: events were dropped, so clients should refetch.

ExportPipelineYamlRequest.description: The pipeline settings to write out as a `version: 2` `.oore.yaml`.

oneOf.description:
The pipeline's App Store Connect settings, for `publish.testflight`.
Only the TestFlight group reaches the file.

execution_config.description: The pipeline's form settings, as `POST /v1/pipelines/validate` takes them.

oneOf.description:
The pipeline's Google Play settings, for `publish.play`. Only the
track, rollout and draft setting reach the file.

The pipeline's trigger settings, for the file's `on`. Left out, the
file has no `on` and the trigger settings keep applying.

errors.description: Why the settings cannot be exported, one per entry.

notes.description: Settings that stay with the pipeline instead of moving to the file.

warnings.description:
Behaviour the file cannot reproduce exactly; each is also a
`WARNING:` comment in the file.

yaml.description:
The generated file. Planned, it runs what the settings run. Secret
values never appear in it; secret references stay as written.

FailingPipelineInsights.description: A pipeline with failed or timed-out builds in the window.

current_streak.description: Failures in a row ending with the newest finished build; 0 once it passed again.

redirect_url.description: Frontend URL to redirect to after GitHub App creation completes.

create_url.description: URL to navigate the browser to — serves an auto-submitting form that POSTs the manifest to GitHub.

GooglePlayCredentialsTestRequest.description:
Which service account key to check against Google Play. The values come
from the form, so a key can be checked before the settings are saved.

package_name.description:
The app to open. When omitted, the saved expected package is used,
then the package of the pipeline's latest Google Play release.

service_account_secret.description: Name of the secret holding the service account JSON key.

Outcome of a Google Play credentials check. A failed check is a normal
answer, with Google's reason in `message`, not an HTTP error.

message.description: What passed, or the exact failure.

package_name.description: The app the check opened, when one was known.

service_account_email.description: The key's `client_email`, when the secret is a service account key.

GooglePlayPublishConfig.description:
Per-pipeline Google Play upload settings. Credentials are referenced by
secret name and never stored here.

draft.description: Create a draft release instead of rolling out.

rollout_percent.description: Initial staged rollout, 0 < percent <= 100. Omitted means 100.

oneOf.description:
Staged rollout schedule, crash-rate halt and approval gate for the
release record. Omitted means the default schedule with no halt.

service_account_secret.description: Name of the secret holding the service account JSON key.

upload_mapping.description: Upload R8/ProGuard `mapping.txt` when the build produced one.

GooglePlayReleaseNotesSource.description: Where Google Play release notes come from.

with the settings the editor holds now.

for repositories that only build manually, where the file's `on`

The trigger settings the file's `on` maps to, with the pipeline's
schedules kept. Left out when the file has no `on`, so the pipeline's
trigger settings stay as they are.

draft.description: Left out, the Publish settings decide.

SMTP settings without the password (email only). Returned when

step.description: One of the build's `retryable_steps`, such as `publish-play`.

custom_labels.description: Labels an operator assigned to this runner.

max_concurrent_builds.description: How many builds the runner runs at the same time.

oneOf.description: Utilisation from the latest heartbeat that carried metrics.

What a pipeline's commit check does when an artifact is over its size
budget. The build itself never fails.

SizeBudgetRule.description: Size limits for one kind of artifact. A rule needs at least one limit.

kind.description:
The artifact kind: its lowercase file extension, such as `aab`,
`apk` or `ipa`.

max_increase_bytes.description: Largest growth allowed compared with the baseline build, in bytes.

max_increase_percent.description: Largest growth allowed compared with the baseline build, in percent.

SlackMention.description: Maps a person to the Slack member mentioned in their notifications.

identity.description:
Oore sign-in email (manual and API builds, releases) or Git username
(push and merge request builds). Matched without regard to case.

SmtpConfigSummary.description:
The SMTP settings an operator can read back. The password is never
returned.

StepPhase.description:
Where a step sits relative to the platform builds. Android signing and the
iOS export seam apply to `build` steps only.

publish_from_file.description:
Publish steps only: where to upload came from the repository's
`.oore.yaml` `publish`, so a retry of the step reads the file at the
build's commit again.

StoreAppVitals.description: Store health of one app: a project shipped to one store under one package name or bundle id.

app_identifier.description: Package name on Google Play, bundle id on the App Store.

error.description: Why the last read failed, such as missing credentials or access.

issues.description: Most-reported issues of the last 28 days. Google Play only.

refreshed_at.description: When Oore last read the store; absent until the first read finishes.

StoreErrorIssue.description: A grouped crash or ANR reported by the store.

url.description: The issue in the store's console.

threshold.description:
Where the store starts treating the value as bad: Play's bad-behavior
threshold, or Apple's recommended goal.

unit.description: Unit as the store names it; `ratio` for Play rates.

value.description: Headline value: Play's 28-day user-weighted rate, or the latest App Store version's value.

StoreVitalKind.description: A store health metric shown on Home.

StoreVitalPoint.description: One point of a store metric: a day for Google Play, an app version for the App Store.

label.description: `YYYY-MM-DD` for Google Play, the app version for the App Store.

TargetSizeBudget.description:
A size budget a repository's `.oore.yaml` version 2 file sets on one
target, after workflow overrides. That platform's commit check enforces it
on top of the pipeline's `size_budget`, which stays a floor.

source.description: Where the budget came from, such as `targets.android.budgets`.

TestRunOutcome.description: One earlier run of a test in the same pipeline.

status.description: `failed`, or `passed` when the build reported tests and this one did not fail.

branches.description:
Branch globs for push and pull request events. When only `tags` is
set, branch events do not trigger.

paths.description:
Push and pull request events trigger only when a changed file matches
one of these globs (`**` spans directories).

paths_ignore.description:
Push and pull request events are skipped when every changed file
matches one of these globs.

tags.description:
Tag globs for tag push events. When only `branches` is set, tag
events do not trigger.

UpdateAppStoreConnectKeyRequest.description:
Rename a shared key or replace it. Omitted fields keep their stored value;
a new `key_id` requires a new private key.

size_budgets.description:
The size budgets the build's `.oore.yaml` version 2 file sets, sent
once the runner planned the build. An empty list means the file sets
none; leaving it out keeps what the build has.

project_id.description:
New project scope. Omit to keep existing; pass empty string to make
the channel instance-wide.

secret.description:
New HMAC secret (webhook) or bot token (slack). Omit to keep existing;
pass empty string to clear.

slack_mentions.description:
New Slack member mappings (Slack only). Omit to keep existing; pass an
empty list to clear.

oneOf.description: Partial SMTP configuration update (email only). Omit fields to keep existing.

url.description: New URL. Omit to keep existing.

oneOf.description:
Omit to keep the stored export method. Changing it discards stored
provisioning profiles because ad hoc and App Store profiles differ.

shared_api_key_id.description:
Use a shared App Store Connect key instead of the pipeline's own.
Omit to keep the current choice; an empty string switches back to the
pipeline's own key.

workflow.description:
A workflow the repository's `version: 2` file defines. `null` clears
it; leaving it out keeps the current one.

UpdatePipelineWorkflowSettingsRequest.description: Replace one workflow's settings. Omitted fields are cleared.

UpdateProjectEnvironmentRequest.description: Changes to an environment. The key and store are fixed once created.

oneOf.description:
Replaces who may approve promotions; leave out (or send null) to keep
them.

custom_labels.description: Replaces the runner's operator labels. Detected labels are kept.

max_concurrent_builds.description: How many builds the runner runs at the same time, from 1 to 8.

UpdateSigningIdentityRequest.description:
Rename an identity, or replace its material (the whole input for its
kind).
